intervention_description: Comprehensive social protection program providing economic support, training, and mentoring to ultra-poor women in rural Haiti

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Programme provides economic resources and transfers to participants
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Health and nutrition messaging is part of the programme components
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Programme provides livestock and economic assets to participants
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Business training and income-generating activities are part of the programme
graduation_components_rationale.savings: No explicit mention of savings mechanisms
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Programme includes case management and mentoring from staff
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No clear evidence of explicit social empowerment activities

outcomes.outcome_description: Kessler Psychological Distress Scale (K6) score, range 0-24, score >13 indicates serious mental illness
outcomes.literal_text: CLM programme has a significant positive effect on maternal mental health

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of community reporting children exposed to harsh corporal punishment
outcomes.literal_text: Proportion reduced from 64.9% to 51.5%, significant treatment effect of -11.9 percentage points

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of community reporting children exposed to violence at home
outcomes.literal_text: Decreased from 42.0% to 37.3%, no significant effect

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of community reporting children exposed to violence outside home
outcomes.literal_text: Increased from 55.7% to 59.6%, no significant impact

outcomes.outcome_description: Number of stimulation activities with children aged 3-5, maximum score of 10
outcomes.literal_text: No impact on number of stimulation activities with children aged 3-5
